title: Defense satellite imagery reveals China's Type 004 nuclear carrier construction at Dalian — SkyFi
snippet: February 2026 satellite imagery of Dalian shipyard reveals China's Type 004 aircraft carrier under construction with reactor compartments visible, estimated 25% complete. Analysis by Tom Shugart (CNAS) identifies nuclear propulsion components and flight deck sections. Ship expected to be China's first nuclear-powered carrier.
